paragraphs.text: A robot can weld a car in seconds but takes minutes to fold a towel. Cloth changes shape as it is touched, so the machine cannot predict what it will be holding next.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: One laboratory solved part of the problem by giving the robot two cheap cameras and letting it shake each item first, which drops the cloth into a small number of predictable shapes.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Laundries are watching. A machine that folds hotel sheets already exists, but the items must be fed in flat, and a human still does that part of the work.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Researchers say the real prize is elsewhere. Handling soft, changing material would help in harvesting fruit and in surgery, where tissue behaves much like cloth.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: Cloth changes shape as it is touched, so the machine cannot predict what it will be holding next
items.prompt: an explanation of why the task is difficult for machines

explanation.en: Cloth changes shape, which makes the task hard — paragraph A.
explanation.kk: Мата пішінін өзгертеді — сондықтан тапсырма қиын, A абзацы.
explanation.ru: Ткань меняет форму — поэтому задача трудная, абзац A.

items.quote: letting it shake each item first, which drops the cloth into a small number of predictable shapes
items.prompt: a trick that made the problem simpler

explanation.en: Shaking reduces the shapes to a few — paragraph B.
explanation.kk: Сілку пішінді бірнеше нұсқаға түсіреді — B абзацы.
explanation.ru: Встряхивание сводит форму к нескольким вариантам — абзац B.

items.quote: Handling soft, changing material would help in harvesting fruit and in surgery
items.prompt: a use of the research outside the home

explanation.en: Fruit picking and surgery are uses outside the home — paragraph D.
explanation.kk: Жеміс жинау мен хирургия — үй сыртындағы қолданыс, D абзацы. C кір жуатын орындар туралы.
explanation.ru: Сбор фруктов и хирургия — применение вне дома, абзац D. В C речь о прачечных, но там машина уже есть.

items.quote: the items must be fed in flat, and a human still does that part of the work
items.prompt: a limit of a machine that is already in use

explanation.en: The existing machine needs items fed in by hand — paragraph C.
explanation.kk: Бар машина қолмен салуды талап етеді — шектеу, C абзацы.
explanation.ru: Существующая машина требует ручной подачи — ограничение, абзац C.
